reasons.deadline: Not published: on the sealed seasons the model beat the base rate (log-loss gain 0.0245, 95% CI 0.0148 to 0.0358) but missed the calibration rule: it predicted 9.2% and 10.5% happened (tolerance 1.1 points; slope 1.095). The league base rate is shown instead.
reasons.arrivals: Not published: on the sealed seasons the model did not beat the base rate with confidence (log-loss gain 0.0030, 95% CI -0.0008 to 0.0070). The league base rate is shown instead.
reasons.type: ESPN's transactions are cached only from March 2024: one season (2024-25) of typed departures, too few to fit and test a type model. The split shown is that season's shares among leavers (a base rate).
reasons.targets: The target ranking did not beat both the need x value ranking and chance on the sealed seasons.

notes: Chance of moving: a ridge logistic regression on our own movement history (who played for which club in every regular-season game since 2009-10), refitted each season and validated on held-out seasons (Model page).

No contract data: cap hits, contract years, no-trade clauses and RFA/UFA status are not used, because no source whose terms allow our use has them. Free agency is inferred from age (27 or older is unrestricted), years since the draft, tenure with the club and role.

Traded or claimed: the box scores show a straight move to another club, not whether it was a trade or a waiver claim. Next season: not in this club's NHL lineup next season (traded, released, signed elsewhere, retired or in the minors all season).
Kind of departure: ESPN's transactions are cached only from March 2024, so the split is the 2024-25 departures' shares (base rates), not a model.
Value is Rink WAR, the last two completed seasons blended 3:2. Rostered: the last club he played for this season.

Outlook: the chance of adding at least one player at the position who was on another NHL club, before the deadline (during the season) or by next season (after it), from a Poisson model of past arrivals (need there, club strength and trajectory, turnover, expected departures). Call-ups from the club's own system are not counted.

Targets: players on other clubs who would upgrade the club's weakest regular slot at their position (third-line centre or winger, second-pair defenceman, starting goalie), ranked by their chance of joining it: the chance he moves x the chance this club is where he goes (a conditional logit on past moves). An estimate from on-field value and history, not news.
